node.title: Re: Best practice validating numerics with regex?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Just because it hasn't been mentioned yet: [mod://Regexp::Common::number] and the core [doc://Scalar::Util#looks_like_number], which is [id://11109063|basically] Perl's core built-in function to check whether a string looks like it contains a number that Perl understands.
